newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Colombo stocks close higher, led by blue chips.
newsitem.headline: Colombo stocks close higher, led by blue chips.

text.p: Sri Lanka stocks closed higher on Monday on brisk buying of blue chips by local and foreign institutions, brokers said.
The Colombo all-share index ended 8.5 points up at 828.2 on turnover of more than 200 million rupees.
"There was heavy foreign buying, mostly in blue chips," said Shanil Perera of Lanka Securities.

"Institutions were very active today and the focus was on blue chips," said Sarinda Unamboowe of John Keells Stock Brokers. He said the market expected some profit-taking on Tuesday as prices had risen faster than expected, but overall the sentiment was bouyant.
